recent_news.headline: Greasing the Wheels of Sustainability: Why Cooking Oil Waste Needs EPR Attention
recent_news.summary: Analyzes the role of used cooking oil in waste management and EPR frameworks, addressing environmental risks from improper disposal and proposing extended producer responsibility as a scalable solution for UCO management.

recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
recent_news.summary: Diamond Green Diesel reported third quarter operating results with its renewable diesel segment earning approximately $350 million in operating income for the three months ended Sept. 30, 2026. Diamond Green Diesel sold 314.9 million gallons of renewable fuels in the third quarter.

recent_news.headline: Clean Harbors Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
recent_news.summary: Clean Harbors reported record Q3 2026 revenue of $1.87 billion (up 21%) and record Adjusted EBITDA of $456 million (up 42%) with EPS of $3.93. A large emergency response job in Los Angeles contributed approximately $120 million in Q3 revenue. The company raised full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $1.44–$1.48 billion.
